title: Cold Rice Keeps Calories Safe

scenes.text: Storing cooked rice for 4 hours changes its calories?
Cooling rice slows the growth of starch‑digesting enzymes, keeping the glycemic impact lower.
scenes.label: ENZYME ACTIVITY REDUCED

scenes.text: A 1‑cup serving of chilled rice has about 10‑15% fewer usable calories than hot rice, due to resistant starch formation.
scenes.label: MORE RESISTANT STARCH
scenes.query: resistant starch in cooled rice calories
scenes.query2: cold rice resistant starch calorie reduction

scenes.text: Refrigerating rice for up to 24 hours keeps it safe and makes it easier to portion for meals, preventing overeating.
scenes.label: SAFE & SATISFYING PORTIONS
